he.text: הוֹרִיתָ דֶּרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה לַבַּת הַשּׁוֹבֵבָה · בֵּין כֶּסֶא לֶעָשׂוֹר עָדֶיךָ נָשׁוּבָה · הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה׃

en.text: Thou didst teach the way of repentance to the backsliding daughter, between the new year’s day and the day of atonement we will return to thee, turn us, then, unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned.

he.text: אָז מֵאָז מִקֶּדֶם הִקְדַּמְתָּ תְשׁוּבָה · בְּטֶרֶם הִמָּתְחוּ אֶרֶץ וִיסוֹדֵי רְגוּבָה · גַּם לְכָל־הַשָּׁבִים צֳרִי וּמַרְפֵּא חֲשׁוּבָה · דּוֹפְקֵי דַּלְתֶךָ רֵיקָם מֵהֲשִׁיבָה׃ הורית

en.text: From the earliest times thou didst prepare repentance; even ere thou spreadedst the earth and its elements thou didst provide this balm, this excellent remedy for the penitent, so that they who knock at thy gates should not return empty. (Thou didst teach, &c.)

he.text: הֵן רֹאשׁ עָפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל אֲשֶׁר רִאשׁוֹן נוֹצַר · וְנִסִּיתוֹ בְּמִצְוָה קַלָּה וְאוֹתָהּ לֹא־נָצַר · זָעַמְתָּ וְאָנַפְתָּ עָלָיו שְׁנוֹתָיו לְקַצֵּר · חָזַר־בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּכְאִישׁוֹן הֻנְצַר׃ הורית

en.text: Lo, the first who was formed of dust, and whom thou didst try with a slight commandment, which he did not keep; thou wast angry with him, and didst determine to curtail his years; but he was penitent, and was kept as the apple of thine eye. (Thou didst teach, &c.)

he.text: טָעָה וְנָע וְדָמֵי־אָחִיו בְּשָׁפְכוֹ · יִסְּרְתּוֹ בְּנָע וָנָד לֵכֶת כֹּה וָכֹה · כָּעֵת שָׁב־אֵלֶיךָ וְעָזַב רוֹעַ־דְּרָכוֹ · לְשִׁבְעָתַיִם הָאָרַכְתּוֹ כָּל־מוֹצְאוֹ בְּלִי־לְהָרְגוֹ׃ הורית

en.text: His son committed a crime of shedding his brother’s blood, then thou didst condemn him to be a fugitive and a vagabond; but when he returned to thee, and forsook his evil ways, thou didst threaten with a seven-fold vengeance any one that should find and slay him. (Thou didst teach, &c.)

he.text: מְחַלֵּל יְצוּעֵי יוֹלְדוֹ אֲשֶׁר־פָּחַז כַּמַּיִם · נָטוּ רַגְלָיו

en.text: He who unstable as water, profaned his father’s bed, had well nigh

he.text: כִּמְעַט לוּלֵי שָׁפַךְ לֵב כַּמַּיִם · סָרַח גּוּר־אַרְיֵה בִּקְדֵשָׁה הִוא בָעֵינַיִם · עֲוֹנוֹ הוֹדָה וְהִכְרַעְתּוֹ לְצֶדֶק בְּכַף־מֹאזְנַיִם׃ הורית

en.text: succumbed to his punishment, if he had not poured out his heart before thee in penitence. (Thou didst teach, &c.) The lion’s whelp committed himself by the wayside; he confessed his sin, and thou didst incline the scale of justice in his favour.
Judah,

he.text: פָּרַץ גְּדֵרוֹת עוֹלָם בֶּן־עָמְרִי בְּרֶשַׁע · צַלְמֵי־אֲשֵׁרִים הִשְׁךְ וְהוֹסִיף עַל־חַטָּאתוֹ פֶּשַׁע · קָרַעְתָּ גְזַר־דִּינוֹ בְּשׁוּבוֹ מִלְּפֶשַׁע · רוּחָם כְּמוֹדֶה וְעוֹזֵב וּבְךָ נוֹשַׁע׃ הורית

en.text: King Ahab, the son of Omri, by his wickedness, broke through all the everlasting hedges, worshipped images and idols, and heaped crime on crime; but when he penitently returned from his misdeeds, thou didst rend his decree, and, having confessed his sins and forsaken them, he found mercy, and was saved. (Thou didst teach, &c.)
1 Kings xvi. 29—33.

he.text: שָׁנְנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם כְּחֵץ אַנְשֵׁי עִיר־גְּדוֹלָה · שׁוֹגְגָם וּזְדוֹנָם רַבּוּ עַד־לְמַעְלָה · תֹּקֶף חָזוֹן הֲפִיכָתָם אֲחָזָם רֶתֶת וְחַלְחָלָה · תְּשׁוּבָה עָשׂוּ כַּהֹגֶן וְלִפְנֵי כִסֵּא־כְבוֹדְךָ נִתְקַבְּלָה׃ הורית

en.text: The inhabitants of that great city had tongues as sharp as arrows, their errors and intentional sins had mightily increased; but when thou didst cause their destruction to be announced to them, they were seized with trembling and terror, and having duly repented, they were received before the throne of thy Majesty. (Thou didst teach, &c.)
Nineveh.

he.text: בּוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וְלֵב נֶאְזָר בִּגְבוּרָה יַדְּעֵנוּ מַדַּע לֶכֶת בְּאֹרַח יְשָׁרָה · מְשׁוּבוֹתֵינוּ אִם־רַבּוּ בְּפֶשַׁע וְסָרָרָה · נָא לְמַעַנְךָ הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ עֲשׂוֹת כַּשּׁוּרָה׃ הורית

en.text: Thou who searchest the innermost heart and who art girded with power, teach us to walk the straight path. If our backslidings, transgressions, and offences have been numerous, we beseech thee turn us for thy sake, and teach us to act justly. (Thou didst teach, &c.)
